hooks.name: frame
hooks.evidence: Frame coordinator: FMOD update at +0xa4412; BeginFrame at +0xa4e5d; restores stack then tail-jumps SubmitFrame at +0xa5273. Only RDI live at entry; indirect caller unresolved statically. IDA ET_DYN analysis copy has only ELF e_type changed; text bytes match original decrypted ELF. No indexed reference enters stolen prologue. Return is ABI-preserving RAX, not asserted engine semantics.

hooks.name: frame_dispatch
hooks.evidence: Whole eboot+0x154e690..0x154e82c instruction body, RDI object, return zero-extended opposite queue offset. XMM0 input is dead before VXORPS. Indirect guest callbacks use original node/vtable; mode and static list bind shared guest storage.

hooks.name: TMNT_DiscardUnusedHeapStats
hooks.evidence: Exact NID k04jLXu3+Ic, sceLibcMspaceMallocStatsFast: RDI heap / RSI versioned 40-byte output / EAX status. Original six-byte RIP-indirect PLT jump preserves caller return PC through trampoline. Only original callers returning to c6362 / c63cd discard stack output and status; real malloc/free execute first. Full decoded evidence and validity boundary in heap-stats.contract.md.
